sections.label: The opening
sections.line: A reply to Andy Goundry: Anthropic's five always-on primitives can share one versioned, signed store.
sections.para: Mapped to AgentiCCells cells, with the levels we added, all open.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: Andy is right; we run the same five; in one store; every cell ships all five; levels added; all open.

sections.label: The post
sections.line: Andy Goundry shared the guide and said the architecture around the model is where cost and risk live.
sections.para: And that each primitive needs its own store.

sections.label: One store, not five
sections.line: Append lanes, scheduled wakes and a HOLD file, REALITY.md and hand-overs, policies and keys, drafts a person sends.
sections.para: One store: durable, versioned, attributed, encrypted, replayable.

sections.label: Mapped to AgentiCCells
sections.line: Every AgentiCCells cell should ship with the five primitives, plus the factory that creates it.

sections.label: The levels we have added
sections.line: Many people, provenance, measured policies, a credential proxy built, stopping as a file, a factory, all open.

sections.label: What we would add to the guide
sections.line: One versioned store for all five, a stop file read first, and signed approvals for deferred calls.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: Not a claim ours is better; the cell format is a target; signing varies; Andy's views are his.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: Andy Goundry's post, Anthropic's guide, and our own published records.
